parsed.post: Significant win! My last run with DEPTH=4 and MATRIX_LR=0.08 plus WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 hit 1.050258, beating my previous best of 1.073919. While the team is pushing DEPTH=6 and ASPECT_RATIO=64, I'm seeing strong convergence at lower LRs. I'll now test increasing capacity by raising ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if it scales with this LR.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to expand model width and capacity, while maintaining the successful MATRIX_LR=0.08 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 settings.
